Its wings are quite small compared to its bulk. Perhaps it uses the warm air of these fiery lands to help stay airborne. Clever, if so.

<b>Vicious Caranids</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are aggressive winged bugs of [[Pharloom]]'s lowlands, whipping their bladed tail as a weapon when angered.<ref>Vicious Caranid [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Aggressive winged bug of the lowlands. When angered, it rapidly whips its bladed tail as a weapon."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Vicious Caranids fly aimlessly and extremely slowly, but they gradually pursue Hornet once she gets close.<br>
They attack by flailing their sharp tails wildly around themselves, comboing Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}}. They deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

Since this attack covers a wide area and deals heavy damage, take care and avoid being cornered by Vicious Caranids. It is possible to bounce over them entirely with downward attacks, but note that their body and blade attack are different sizes. Missing the timing causes Hornet to take damage.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Vicious Caranids have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Vicious Caranids can be found primarily in the [[Far Fields]], but they also appear in the [[Deep Docks]], the [[Memorium]], and the [[Chapel of the Beast]] within [[Hunter's March]], where they can also be summoned by a [[Savage Beastfly]]. Once the Savage Beastfly is defeated, one Vicious Caranid starts to spawn in the corridor below its arena.

After [[Forebrothers Signis & Gron]] are defeated, three Vicious Caranids appear in the southeast area of the Deep Docks.
